intent: Make the zsh completion script safe to source directly (source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)) by registering via compdef instead of calling _rg unconditionally, and document the approach in the FAQ. Closes #2956.

findings.title: Sourcing before compinit still runs _rg outside completion context and errors
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the (( ! $+functions[compdef] )) branch only for the ci/test-complete harness (e.g. let the harness define a stub compdef or set a variable it checks), so a user who sources the script before compinit gets a no-op or a clear hint rather than the original _arguments error; and document in FAQ.md that the source line must come after compinit (and the fpath line before it).
findings.why_it_matters: The PR fixes the error in #2956 only when compinit has already run. If compdef is undefined (source line placed before compinit in .zshrc, a common ordering), the guard falls into the _rg call branch and zsh prints '_rg:341: command not found: _arguments' (reproduced with zsh 5.8.1 using zsh -f -c 'source ./rg.zsh'); the completion is also never registered. The FAQ recommends the source one-liner without stating the ordering requirement.
evidence: Reproduced: zsh -f -c 'source ./rg.zsh' -> '_rg:341: command not found: _arguments', rc=1
Reproduced: after compinit, source, source <(cat), eval and sourcing from a function all register _comps[rg]=_rg with rc=0
Autoloaded _rg file in fpath still registers correctly

findings.title: FAQ zsh text has a grammar error and a prompt marker inside a .zshrc snippet
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to 'while this approach is easier to set up, it is generally slower than the previous method and will add time to loading your shell prompt.' and drop the leading '$ ' from the line meant to be pasted into .zshrc.
findings.first_evidence: Note though that while this approach is easier to setup, is generally slower
findings.why_it_matters: The sentence is ungrammatical (missing subject), and the snippet is introduced as something to add to $HOME/.zshrc yet is written with a shell prompt '$ ', which would be a syntax error if pasted literally.
evidence: FAQ.md: '$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)' under 'add the following to your $HOME/.zshrc file'

residual_risks: ci/test-complete was not runnable (needs built rg); its sourcing of rg.zsh without compdef relies on the second branch of the guard.
The guard depends on $funcstack[1] being _rg when autoloaded from fpath; verified registration with zsh 5.8.1 only.
testing_gaps: No automated check covers the source-then-compdef path; ci/test-complete exercises only the no-compdef branch.

coverage.notes: Lite path ran in a single context; no reviewer agents dispatched. No CODING_STANDARDS.md, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md govern the changed files. No plan found. Declared Compound Packs not applied. Not assessed: learnings, agent-native gaps, deployment notes. Scratch zsh checks run under work dir (zsh 5.8.1).
